records.name: Sepp Seilschluss
records.biography_en: He leads the rope team by considering every alternative a loose end. His rope coil keeps the expedition's responsibilities in a reassuring knot. HyperNorm calls residents secured or a loose end. A dissonant card has made him ask who wants to lead the next stretch instead of tightening his grip. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Seilschaft steht. Abweichende Richtungen gelten als Materialfrage.

variant_notes.note_en: He leads the rope team by considering every alternative a loose end.

records.name: Ida Eisvorbehalt
records.biography_en: She trusts a good edge more than an encouraging speech. She carries the short iceaxe as a practical answer to surfaces the building considers regrettably uncooperative. Residents are either firm or unreliable. An ambiguous card has taught her that reassurance can sometimes hold where another sharp instruction would slip. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Kante hält. Ermutigung ist für weichere Stellen vorgesehen.

variant_notes.note_en: She trusts a good edge more than an encouraging speech.

records.name: Bodo Boulderamt
records.biography_en: He loves a short climb provided it does not involve falling from one. His chalk bag contains enough preparation for a climb that remains inconveniently real. HyperNorm classifies fear as sensible or embarrassing according to rank. A contradictory card has made him tell a nervous neighbour that stopping is allowed. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Route ist kurz. Der mögliche Fall wurde nicht entsprechend gekürzt.

variant_notes.note_en: He loves a short climb provided it does not involve falling from one.

records.name: Mara Markierung
records.biography_en: She knows the route and is increasingly doubtful about the destination. Her route map has three confident arcs and a destination she increasingly distrusts. The building files paths as approved or lost. A dissonant card has made her mark a resting place where nobody needs to justify staying. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist bekannt. Über das Ziel bestehen begründete Restfragen.

variant_notes.note_en: She knows the route and is increasingly doubtful about the destination.

records.name: Oskar Obenluft
records.biography_en: He has reached impressive heights and would like the air to acknowledge it. He carries an altimeter to prove that being short of air is at least happening somewhere impressive. HyperNorm calls ascent progress and descent failure. An ambiguous card has made him consider that getting everyone home might be the real achievement. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Höhe ist bestätigt. Die Luft bleibt eine persönliche Angelegenheit.

variant_notes.note_en: He has reached impressive heights and would like the air to acknowledge it.

records.name: Toni Tragweite
records.biography_en: He carries what the expedition calls essentials and what the leader calls not much. The bedroll and lunchbox are essentials when carried by somebody else. HyperNorm files support as routine until it disappears. A contradictory card has persuaded him to put the load down and share lunch before accepting another small request. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er trägt das Nötigste. Die Definition stammt von den anderen.

variant_notes.note_en: He carries what the expedition calls essentials and what the leader calls not much.
